results.yieldBasis: Complete grouped positive-provider surface with exact catalog, active-county geography, current D_start, completed-run, prior-plan, and rejection-set subtraction.
results.decision: Execute all 15 exact anti-dup state plans because the source exceeds the conditional threshold, has explicit positive cover, exact county FIPS, public unauthenticated access, and zero monetary cost.

results.sourceFamilyNewness: existing source family; national points and generalized-area contract would be new
results.confidence: medium for point estimate; high for no-go classification
blockers: Estimated net yield is below the 2000-pair conditional threshold.
The dynamic point and area layers require a new sealed national adapter and explicit derived-product attribution notices.
Host fields cannot be promoted as host occurrence, and source silence cannot create absence or non-detection.

results.sourceFamilyNewness: existing source family; per-collection Darwin Core archive contract would be new
results.authority: SERNEC academic aggregator with collection-level publishers
results.confidence: low; the eight complete archives were small and not a stratified national sample
blockers: The currently unambiguous CC0 subset projects below the 2000-pair conditional threshold.
Portal-wide policy asks users not to redistribute occurrence data while the repository is public.
Non-CC0 raw archive retention and derived redistribution require written clarification or a private immutable artifact contract.

results.sourceFamilyNewness: existing source family; current county snapshot contract would be new
results.authority: Georgia Forestry Commission hosted ArcGIS layer, corroborated by USDA Forest Service materials
blockers: Exact net yield is below the 2000-pair conditional threshold.
Layer terms and copyright fields do not document reuse or raw-response retention permission.
Records contain no taxon or method field, so disease-label to catalog-synonym mapping needs a curated decision.
Null or default not-yet-detected rows cannot support absence.

decisionSummary.reason: BLM AIM is the only evaluated source above the current conditional execution threshold. The other candidates are recorded as durable no-go lanes so later rounds do not repeat the same research without a changed snapshot, rights posture, or yield basis.
